# DCH round 7 guard-removal table

Serial by family and by guard or named duplicate set. Every row restores its guard before the next. No accepting shortcut or unrelated guard removal is used. Negative IDs resolve in DCH-guard-negative-index.json; “all other” means its exact complement.

Named duplicate sets retain the existing schema/semantic, scope-dispatch, selected/registered identifier and failed-exit sets. Failed-test exit-code base/conditional bounds remain named duplicates. The shared UTC grammar is duplicated by payload.ts and EventRecord date_time_string; these copies are removed together. Eight independent parser-predicate rows separately prove grammar/calendar/hour/minute/second and HTTPS grammar/IPv6/zone checks. Protected original-recipe selection, source custody, saved-original retry comparison and exact raw MessagePack pack bytes have their own witnesses. The input type/domain boundary is called by several readers; removing its exact shared wrapper affects those identical calls. The encoder safe-integer gate has its own direct removal row; RFC8785/MessagePack refusal fallback remains active.
